title: Cocoon session receipt (BioChain bridge)
description: Produced at session end only when the optional BioChain bridge is enabled. The session's command stream is folded into BioChain SHD-CCP 64-bit kernel words, and the biofeedback log into crystallized packets. The receipt carries a holonomy fingerprint and a hyperbolic coherence trajectory. Raw biometric data never leaves the cocoon; only digests do.

kernel_verified.description: true when the words were cross-checked against the BioChain protocol/shdccp_kernel.py reference
